comment: Bugs 6 and 8 of the hunt of 2026-10-08, the Layers docker's pictures. A document of 1920 by 1280, the photograph of the harness's references imported as a layer, and an effect layer called Kaleidoscope made above it, reading it, with the kaleidoscope attached at eight mirrors, as the scenario builds it. Shot 1 is the docker beside the canvas: the Kaleidoscope row's picture is the kaleidoscope the canvas shows, where it was a small copy of the photograph. Then the canvas is cropped to a selection of 960 by 720, which changes the picture's shape and so its texture, and shot with no wait at all, which is the hunt's moment, and again thirty frames later, and rotated 90 degrees clockwise and shot the same two ways: every row's picture is drawn in all four, where the two straight after were white squares. Last a perf window over a stroke on the photograph and forty frames, whose block says what the effect row's pictures cost: the kaleidoscope's dispatches and the thumbnail kernel's.
